subject: Pre-demo intake — security & IdP prerequisites (NDA / SSO metadata)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliumhealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@heliumhealth.com, Jason Lee <jason@idpsetup.io>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-demo checklist / vendor intake (scheduled Jul 21)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the invite — we have Wed Jul 21 at 10:00am PT on the calendar for the product walkthrough. Before we can open conference access and allocate a room for our clinical team, Procurement and IT asked that we complete a few intake items: a signed NDA (Procurement), a filled security questionnaire (attached), and SSO metadata from the vendor for our IdP team (to validate SCIM/SAML).

Procurement is keen on seeing the completed questionnaire and a redlined NDA back by EOD Mon Jul 20. Our IdP team is short-staffed next week (travel + OOO) so they flagged that SSO metadata may not be available until the week of Jul 26.

Can you confirm whether the demo can proceed without SSO metadata (e.g., show a hosted-api demo with mock SSO) or if we should push the session to the week of Jul 27? I attached the questionnaire — feel free to call out anything we should pre-fill on our side.

Attachments: Helium_Procurement_Questionnaire_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 276 KB)

Best,
Samira
Director of Partnerships
Helium Health

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-16T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-demo checklist / vendor intake (scheduled Jul 21)

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the questionnaire.

Quick summary from our side: Procurement/IT gating is common and makes sense. Two notes that affect the demo:
- NDA + questionnaire: we can accept the NDA and review the security questionnaire ahead of time; please upload the signed NDA and any completed sections to the HubSpot deal link so our security team can triage.
- SSO metadata: if IdP metadata isn't available by Jul 21, we can run a controlled demo that focuses on the Redwood hosted API and solution architecture (no production SSO). That demo will not require provisioning into your IdP or access to private data; it's useful for product fit but not full end-to-end SSO testing.

Given your procurement timeline (NDA by EOD Jul 20) and potential IdP delay, I recommend two options:
1) Keep Jul 21 slot as a high-level walkthrough (hosted API, architecture, security controls) and mark it as "non-integrated demo" in the invite.
2) Move the full integrated demo until week of Jul 27 once SSO metadata is available — this would be the session where our solutions engineer brings the IdP-configured flow.

Laura / Priyom / Aditya — can you weigh in on whether option (1) is a reasonable short-form demo and what we should ship as pre-read (Redwood_PreDemo_Guide.pdf attached)? Also, Priyom — if Helium uploads the partially completed questionnaire, can your team do a quick risk triage so procurement has an answer before Jul 20?

Attachments: Redwood_PreDemo_Guide.pdf (application/pdf, 312 KB)

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliumhealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@heliumhealth.com, Jason Lee <jason@idpsetup.io>
Date: 2026-07-17T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-demo checklist / vendor intake (scheduled Jul 21)

Thanks Markus — appreciate the flexibility. Quick updates from Procurement/IT:
- Procurement confirmed they will sign the NDA via DocuSign and expect to have it executed by Jul 20 (I will forward the signed copy). DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/party/abcdef123456
- Security questionnaire: we will upload the filled sections tonight; a few answers need vendor confirmation (I'll mark those).
- IdP / SSO metadata: our IdP engineer is on travel until Jul 24 and then has limited availability the 25–26; realistic earliest we can provide full SAML metadata is Mon Jul 27.

Given that, we prefer to push the integrated demo to the week of Jul 27 so we can do the end-to-end flow with our internal user accounts. Is Redwood available Tue Jul 28 or Wed Jul 29 in the afternoon PT?

If you can do a short 20–30m pre-demo on Jul 21 that does not require SSO (option 1), we can still take it — but we'd like to prioritize the integrated walkthrough for when IdP metadata is present.

Samira

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, procurement@heliumhealth.com
Date: 2026-07-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-demo checklist / vendor intake (scheduled Jul 21)

Samira — that plan works. Thank you for the clear timeline. Next steps from Redwood: 
- We'll mark the existing Jul 21 invite as a "product overview (no SSO)" and reduce to 30 minutes; Aditya will run that session if you want a short preview for stakeholders.
- Move the integrated demo to Tue Jul 28 or Wed Jul 29 afternoon PT — Aditya, Laura, Priyom: which of these dates can you support?
- Priyom: please confirm you can triage the partially completed questionnaire once Samira uploads it and provide a short summary back to Procurement by EOD Jul 20.
- Samira: when you have the DocuSign NDA and the partial upload, drop the links into the HubSpot deal thread (or reply-all here) so we can close the procurement loop.

We want to avoid blocking your team while procurement completes their steps; if your stakeholders would still like an introductory demo on Jul 21 (non-integrated), we'll keep that in place. Otherwise we'll update the calendar to the integrated slot on Jul 28/29 after IdP metadata is available.

Thanks — will follow up once dates are confirmed.

Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
